facts.fact: Subscribers: 15,384 at 2025-06 (Q2 2025), per the NCA, satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana, up from 10,362 at Q4 2024 and 11,982 at Q1 2025.
Subscribers: 2,666 at 2024-03 (Q1 2024), per the NCA, satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana before Starlink was licensed.
The NCA states it licensed Starlink in April 2024, under the Satellite Licensing Framework 2024, and that Ghana has 29 satellite licences of which 11 provide last-mile connectivity.
The NCA states satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana exceeded 15,000 by June 2025, sold by licensed last-mile satellite providers (11 licensed), following Starlink's licensing.
